question: For which social class is the increasing liṅga measure commended?
premises: The liṅga is described as increasing in measure.
This increasing measure is evaluated as commended.
It is deemed fit for warriors.
inference: An increasing liṅga measure is commended as fit for the kṣatriya class.
plain_english: In the case of an increasing liṅga, this measure is commended as fit for warriors.
